periods.time: After possessed Stella nearly kills Shizuku

name.zh: 爱德怀斯制止一辉并开辟救回史黛菈的道路
name.en: Edelweiss Stops Ikki and Opens the Route to Save Stella

periods.location: Burned ruins above the destroyed Nikko laboratory
periods.summary: Edelweiss stops Ikki's self-destructive attempt to kill possessed Stella, while Ouma and Shizuku prove Stella remains reachable and create a plan to send Ikki into her body.
periods.cause: Eilands controls Stella's body and tries to kill Shizuku. Ikki, believing Stella's self gone, enters Excessive Awakening and prepares to kill Stella to protect what she loved.
periods.process: Edelweiss intercepts Ikki's causal blade and severs his horn, condemning the form as weakness because he has abandoned tomorrow. Ouma, though gravely burned, reminds Ikki that victory is his true weakest strength, not giving up. Shizuku points out Eilands' behavior is irrational if Stella were truly erased: he must still fear their voices reaching her. She proposes using her last magic to fuse Ikki into Stella. Edelweiss agrees to hold Eilands in place and entrusts the rescue to Shizuku.
periods.outcome: Ikki regains the will to save Stella rather than kill her. Shizuku absorbs Ikki to stabilize herself, prepares the fusion, and Edelweiss begins suppressing Eilands-possessed Stella.
casualties: Ikki's Excessive Awakening horn cut by Edelweiss
all student rescuers remain critically injured
periods.significance: Turns the battle from tragic execution toward actual rescue and redefines Ikki's strength as fighting for tomorrow with others rather than sacrificing all alone.
